params.name: isOnline
params.description: Whether the device is currently online.

params.name: isBooked
params.description: Whether the device is currently booked.

params.name: platformVersion
params.description: The platform / OS version of the device.

params.name: deviceName
params.description: The device name; accepts an exact name or a comma-separated list of names.

params.name: appiumDisabled
params.description: Filter by whether the device can run Appium automation tests.

params.name: groupId
params.description: For organization users, restrict to devices in a device group.

items.docs: Returns all devices the current user can access - public cloud, favorites, and private/local devices - with device metadata. Supports filtering to locate a device to book for a test run.
